My father got really deep into ancestry mapping a while back.

His mother's side was Catholic, so there's meticulous records of generations of families from the church.

His fathers side—he tracked about two generations back before it just became "many years of illiterate swamp people"
I wear my Baltimore Crabs hat every day still
Willing to bet the farm that he couldn't point to Lake Ontario on a map
The dankest nugs will always be chicken
For real tho; where is the streetwise Hercules to fight the rising odds?

I think I might get into the "giant stone doors in an ancient temple that need several magic stones to unlock" business

If anyone has a good lead for a client lmk
